intro: Hi, I'm VERUS! This is me at work for the owner of three fictional manufacturers we built for demonstrations: Kestwood, Marchetti and Brightwater.
01-sign-in: I run inside your network, and I only read. I never change a thing in your systems.
02-portfolio: The owner starts here: every company side by side, on one set of definitions, each in its own currency.
03-region-pnl: One click down, the P and L, plant by plant. Brightwater made money in August. Its Phoenix plant lost almost eighteen thousand dollars.
04-reported: Phoenix's pack said it made twelve thousand. The systems say otherwise, and everyone sees both at the same time.
05-first100: Buy a company, and on day one I tell you what it is, what normal looks like, and where to look first.
06-board-pack: Every month, a board pack, with the source of every number.
07-quiet: And I tell the owner when a key customer goes quiet: no contact in a hundred and seven days.
08-brief: The plants get the same numbers. Every morning, the plant manager gets a brief from me: what changed yesterday, and what needs a decision.
09-show-me: Press Show me on any line, and I light up the numbers behind it.
10-right-now: And I don't stop at the morning. Every fifteen minutes I read the newest scrap and downtime. If a machine is running far past its normal, I flag it within minutes, on your phone, while the shift can still fix it.
11-finding-plan: Each problem names the customer and the number, and I propose a plan, with owners and the date it gets judged.
12-sisters: Your plant in full, and your sister plants' headline numbers right beside it.
13-ask: Ask me a question in plain words. I'll answer, and show you exactly how I worked it out.
14-agent: Need something watched? Describe an agent in one sentence. I'll show you what it would have caught last year.
15-documents: Your own documents answer too, with the page each answer came from.
outro: I'm VERUS. I watch your data all day, so you see the smoke before the fire. See me on your own data, read-only, inside your network.
